subject: SIG launch preflight: answers needed to start questionnaire
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medivance.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG launch preflight: answers needed to start questionnaire

Hi Lena — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + a short preflight so our security team can pick the right questionnaire and evidence path.

Recap from call:
- You confirmed Medivance will require HIPAA alignment and are asking about GDPR residency for a subset of EU patients.
- You prefer a SIG/CAIQ path but are open to a brief custom form for hosting/residency specifics.
- Timeline: you want vendor questionnaires kicked off this month ahead of the integration review.

Preflight asks (can you confirm these 4 items so we pick the right form?):
1) SOC 2 status: do you need a full SOC 2 Type II report or is a SOC 2 Type I + SOC 2 controls mapping sufficient for your procurement/legal review?
2) Data residency: any non-US residency requirement for Medivance-managed patient data? If yes, please list countries/regions and whether data-in-transit is allowed through non-US regions.
3) PHI handling: will Redwood be processing PHI on day 1 (e.g., clinical notes, identifiers) or only de-identified/hashed tokens?
4) KMS/keys: do you require customer-managed keys (CMK) / HSM integration or is Redwood-managed KMS acceptable?

I attached a short prefill spreadsheet (redwood-sig-prefill.xlsx) that mirrors the SIG fields — filling it out will speed things up. If SOC 2 is required, I attached a one-page summary of our SOC 2 scope (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).

Next steps once we get your answers:
- We’ll pick SIG vs CAIQ vs custom field set and return a one-page evidence map.
- Karthik will own the technical evidence gather (network diagram, dataflow, KMS screenshots) and Ben will coordinate SOC 2 / legal attachments.

Can you confirm answers by EOD Friday (9/4)? We can also take a 20m follow-up if helpful.

Thanks — Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-sig-prefill.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medivance.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@medivance.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG launch preflight: answers needed to start questionnaire

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below to help you route the questionnaire: 

1) SOC 2: We will need a SOC 2 Type II report for vendors that process PHI; however, for initial procurement we accept a Type I + controls mapping as a stopgap if Type II is in process with an expected date. Please indicate expected Type II availability if not already completed.
2) Data residency: Primary residency must be US for PHI. For anonymized/aggregated EU data we may accept EU-hosted storage; for now assume US-only for PHI.
3) PHI handling: yes — Redwood will be processing PHI when integrated (clinical notes and identifiers). We will request BAAs and dataflow diagrams.
4) KMS/keys: We prefer customer-managed keys (HSM or CMK) for PHI datasets; please note if Redwood supports a KMS integration or if there is a timeline to add CMK support.

We’ll fill the prefill spreadsheet and return it by Friday. For context, security@medivance.com is the review body and will request redlines through procurement if necessary.

If redwood has an example BAA template or a short KMS integration doc, please attach.

Regards,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Vendor Risk\Medivance Health

Lena — perfect, thanks for the quick clarification. Couple of follow-ups based on your answers: 

- SOC 2 Type II status: our most recent Type II report covers user authentication, change management, and encryption-at-rest/in-transit for our hosted offering; our next Type II audit window is Q4 2026. I’ve attached the one-page summary; Ben can provide the redacted report on request.
- KMS/CMK: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via our Dedicated/Private offering today; for Hosted API we offer bring-your-own-key (BYOK) roadmap but not immediate HSM CMK. If Medivance requires CMK day 1 for PHI in Hosted, we should discuss Dedicated or Private.

Action items for our side:
- I’ll assign the SIG path as primary (we’ll prefill and send back).
- Karthik — can you prepare a dataflow diagram and note where PHI is tokenized vs stored? Ideally a draft by next Wed (9/8).
- Ben — please have a redacted SOC 2 Type II ready; if we need to propose a timeline to complete Type II in Q4 I’ll add that to the procurement note.

If Medivance wants CMK for Hosted-only integration, we should surface the Dedicated offering with expected onboarding time (Ben/Karthik, can you include an estimate).

Thanks — Naomi
